steps.step: Ask Rachel who in leadership decides on a second platform, and offer a one-page outline of the Lakestream side-by-side for her to bring to that person. (owner Isaac Morgan, due 2026-10-02). Why: Leadership was mentioned only generically, so the signer is easy to leave unnamed while the focus stays on the cost comparison.

judge.critique: Strong step that targets the unnamed leadership signer (Rachel in U011) and gives her a forwardable outline; the weakest point is that the outline predates Tobias's volumes and Lena's comparison, so it must stay numberless and structural until the Oct 14 review.

steps.step: Send Tobias a short list of what the cost comparison needs (event volumes per hour, required refresh, add-on scope), and tell Rachel it lands about a week after the volumes arrive, before the October 14th review. (owner Lena Fischer, due 2026-10-01). Why: A vague volume request risks a second round, and the CRM logs the commitment without a date. Say 'about a week', not a firm date.

judge.critique: Weakest is r7: a data request checklist plus a timing note is largely coordination hygiene, and it does not prepare Rachel to answer leadership's 'why not expand Lakestream' question or address the Oct 20 renewal; adding a short outline of the side by side (Apex vs Lakestream plus add-on, all-in cost) she can forward would lift it.
